project.name: Avenor head office fit-out, Level 14 Wenlock Place
project.address: Level 14, 211 Wenlock Terrace, North Sydney NSW 2060
project.summary: Tenant fit-out of the whole of Level 14 (1,200 m2 NLA) of Wenlock Place, an occupied 24-storey A-grade Class 5 office tower in North Sydney completed in 2008, handed over in base-building condition. The interior designer leads a traditional lump-sum tender under AS 4000; a private certifier issues a CDC; fit-out budget $2,400,000 ex GST.

firms: Meridale Building Services Engineers Pty Ltd
Baxter Lane Cost Consultants Pty Ltd
places: Wenlock Place, 211 Wenlock Terrace, North Sydney (invented street)
205 Wenlock Terrace (invented heritage item next door)
